authPanel.label: Security commitments
authPanel.title: Care, safely delivered
authPanel.lead: Controlled access. Protected data. Trust at the heart of every act of care.
authPanel.accessNotice: Access restricted to authorised staff. Every sign-in is logged.

login.title: Sign in to your workspace
login.lead: Use your professional account to access Sanjeevani EMR.

network.title: The network connection was interrupted
network.text: Check your Internet connection, then try again. No request could be confirmed.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

invalid.title: Unable to sign in
invalid.hint: Check your details and try again.

rate.title: Too many attempts, try again in {time}
rate.text: To protect your access, new attempts are temporarily suspended.

unavailable.title: The sign-in service is unavailable
unavailable.text: A technical incident prevents sign-in. Please try again in a few moments.

mfa.title: Verify your identity
mfa.lead: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
mfa.hint: Paste the 6 digits or type them in order.
mfa.clockNote: Your device’s clock must be set to update automatically. No code will ever be asked of you by phone.

invalid.title: This code is incorrect or has expired
invalid.text: Wait for the next code in your app, then try again.

expired.title: Sign in again to continue
expired.lead: The safety of your patients remains our priority.
expired.noticeText: To protect health data, your session was closed automatically.
expired.kept: Your page has been kept. Once your identity is verified, you will resume your consultation where you left off.

setup.title: Create your password
setup.lead: Replace the temporary password given to you by your administrator.

errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

breached.title: This password has appeared in a data breach
breached.text: Choose a unique password that you do not use on any other service.

inactivity.title: Are you still there?
inactivity.lead: With no activity, your session will be closed automatically. Confirm you are here to continue.
inactivity.draftText: Your clinical note was saved at {time}. It will be available the next time you sign in.

errors.min: The value must be at least {min}.
errors.max: The value must be at most {max}.
errors.equalsField: The two values do not match.
errors.passwordPolicy: The password does not meet the security policy.

qr.alt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app

shell.auditNotice: Your access to this record is logged.

admin.auditNote: This action is recorded in the audit log with your identity.

errors.network: The network connection was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

organization.title: Organization
organization.lead: The hospital or hospital group run by this installation. There is only one.
organization.name: Organization name
organization.nameHint: Renaming the organization changes neither its sites nor the data attached to them.
organization.firstRunTitle: The organization is not configured yet
organization.firstRunText: Enter its name to create it. You can then register its sites.
organization.readOnly: Only the system administrator can change the organization.

sites.title: Sites
sites.lead: The organization’s facilities. Each site has its own structure: services, units, rooms and beds.
sites.codeHint: Four characters (digits or capitals), three (digits or lowercase), two digits, separated by hyphens.
sites.codeFormat: The code does not match the expected format (example: YDE1-hcy-01).
sites.name: Name
sites.initialStatusHint: A site created “under construction” is not operational yet.
sites.disruptiveTitle: This status interrupts the site’s activity
sites.disruptiveText: The site will no longer be considered open. Make sure no patient is being cared for there.

structure.title: Site structure
structure.lead: Services, units, rooms and beds of each site. Nothing is deleted: an element is deactivated.
structure.noSites: No site is registered: the structure is built site by site.
structure.name: Name
structure.codeHint: Letters, digits, “_”, “-” or “.” (32 characters at most). The code can no longer be changed.
structure.codeFormat: The code may only contain letters, digits, “_”, “-” and “.”.
structure.deactivateTitle: This element will no longer receive anyone
structure.deactivateText: It stays readable and you can reactivate it at any time. Make sure it is no longer in use.
structure.blockedText: This element contains active elements. Deactivate them first, starting with the lowest levels (beds, then rooms, then units).
structure.empty: This site has no service, unit or bed yet.

users.title: Users
users.lead: The accounts that can access the installation. Disabling an account or changing its roles takes effect immediately.
users.inactiveNoRights: Account disabled: no rights at all.
users.rolesEffectText: The chosen list replaces the current roles. The account’s open sessions are cut and its rights recomputed.
users.disableTitle: This account will no longer be able to sign in
users.disableText: All its sessions are cut immediately. You can re-enable it at any time.
users.resetMfaTitle: The owner will have to enroll two-factor authentication again
users.resetMfaText: Use it when their phone is lost: the secret and the recovery codes are erased and their sessions cut.
users.createdText: Give the temporary password to {username} through a safe channel. They will have to change it on first sign-in.
users.onceTitle: It will not be shown again
users.onceText: Write it down or copy it now: once this panel is closed it cannot be retrieved.
users.done: I have passed the password on

roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: What each role allows. An account combines the rights of all its roles.
roles.readOnlyText: Roles are installation data. Creating and editing them is not available in the interface yet.
roles.showOf: Show the rights of the {name} role
roles.hideOf: Hide the rights of the {name} role

dashboard.title: My workspace
dashboard.subtitle: View of {date} · Context and tools tailored to your role.

perimeterOf.department: Patients under my care · My department

dashboard.scopeText: Navigation entries and actions follow the rights of the signed-in role.
dashboard.locked: Locked: Role administration: access not authorised

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Professional details · Roles are managed by your administrator.

errors.phone: Enter a valid number (digits and spaces, leading “+” for international).

profile.signatureHint: Signature on file · Replace after verification
profile.notSavedText: Your input is valid, but the profile update service is not connected yet: nothing was changed.

modules.soon: This module will be available soon.

recovery.title: Use a recovery code
recovery.lead: Can’t reach your app? Use one of the codes you saved when securing your account.
recovery.noticeTitle: Each code can be used only once
recovery.noticeText: The code you enter will be invalidated after verification.
recovery.noCode: No code left? Contact your administrator to restore secure access.

errors.format: The code is 5 characters, a hyphen, then 5 characters.

accepted.title: Recovery code accepted
accepted.text: This code has been used and can no longer be used. Remember to renew your codes if you have none left.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Enter your username or work e-mail address to request a reset link.

errors.required: Enter your username or e-mail address.

privacy.title: Your privacy is protected
privacy.text: If an account matches this information, a message will be sent to the address on file. The answer is the same in every case.

sent.title: Request recorded
sent.text: If an account matches this information, a message has been sent to the address on file. The answer is the same in every case.

unavailable.title: Reset by e-mail not available yet
unavailable.text: Contact your facility’s administrator to get a new password.

failed.title: Request failed
failed.text: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

authenticator.title: Add an authenticator
authenticator.lead: Install Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Aegis, then add your work account.

scan.title: 1. Scan this QR code
scan.text: In your app, choose “Add account”, then “Scan a QR code”.

help.title: Code not recognised?
help.text: Turn on automatic date and time on your phone. Wait for the next code, then try again.

recoveryCodes.title: Keep your codes
recoveryCodes.lead: These codes let you sign in if you lose your phone. Each code works only once.
recoveryCodes.noticeText: Keep them away from this device, in a safe place. Never send them by e-mail.
recoveryCodes.saved: I have kept these codes in a safe place
recoveryCodes.helper: Confirm you have kept the codes to continue.
recoveryCodes.helperSaved: Keeping the codes is confirmed. You can continue.
recoveryCodes.fileTitle: Recovery codes (single use) — keep in a safe place

ready.title: Your account is ready
ready.lead: Your professional access is now secured. Welcome, {name}.
ready.noticeText: All three steps protecting your account have been completed.
ready.note: A two-step verification will be requested before you choose your work context.

billing.auditNote: This action is recorded in the audit log with your identity.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.lead: Patient invoices: what is due, what has been collected, what remains to be paid.

new.title: New invoice
new.lead: Find the patient, then add the items to bill.
new.queryHint: Record number (PAT-0000123) or first and last name (at least 2 letters per word).
new.queryRequired: Enter a record number or a name.
new.refine: {shown} records shown out of {total}: refine the search to narrow it down.

detail.noLines: No item yet: add some to be able to issue the invoice.
detail.noCash: You have no open cash drawer: open it to be able to collect payments.

lines.title: Add an item
lines.quantityInvalid: The quantity is an integer from 1 to 9999.

discount.title: Discount
discount.amountHint: On the whole invoice; it cannot exceed the total.
discount.needsApproval: This discount exceeds {percent}% of the invoice ({limit}): it will be sent to a supervisor, who will approve or reject it.

issue.title: Issue the invoice
issue.warningText: Once issued, its items and discount can no longer be changed: it can then be paid.

cancelInvoice.title: Cancel the invoice
cancelInvoice.warningText: A cancelled invoice is locked and no longer due. An invoice that has been paid cannot be cancelled: it must be refunded.

collect.title: Collect payment
collect.amountHint: The balance by default; enter less for a partial payment.
collect.remaining: {left} will remain to be paid after this payment.
collect.tenderedLow: The amount handed over is lower than the amount collected ({amount}).

reprint.title: A copy, not an original
reprint.text: The reprinted receipt is marked “DUPLICATE”. The reprint is recorded in the audit log with its reason.

catalog.title: Price catalog
catalog.lead: Billable items and their price. Prices are changed from the administration side.
catalog.name: Name

session.title: My cash drawer
session.lead: Open your drawer by counting your float, collect payments, then close it by counting what you hold.
session.openLead: Without an open drawer no payment can be collected. Count the notes and coins of your float.
session.counterHint: A counter has only one open drawer at a time.
session.floatLegend: Float: number of notes and coins
session.reasonHint: Required if the drawer does not balance.
session.reasonRequired: The drawer does not balance: explain the variance.
session.previewReview: The variance exceeds {limit}: a supervisor will have to co-sign the closing.
session.closedText: Your drawer is closed. Print the handover sheet to hand over with the cash.
session.awaitingText: The variance exceeds the limit: a supervisor must validate the closing. You can open another drawer.

sessions.title: Cash sessions
sessions.lead: Open and closed drawers, with each one's variance. A supervisor validates closings whose variance exceeds the limit.

cosign.title: You are validating a cash variance
cosign.text: The variance exceeds the limit. Co-sign only after checking with the cashier; you cannot validate your own drawer.

approval.title: Approvals
approval.lead: A discount above the limit or the cancellation of an issued invoice needs a supervisor’s approval. Pending requests come first.
approval.leadOwn: Your approval requests and what became of them. A supervisor accepts or rejects each one; you can withdraw one that is still waiting.
approval.outdated: The invoice has changed since this request: it can no longer be approved, only rejected or withdrawn.
approval.approveText: The discount or cancellation is applied to the invoice right away. You cannot decide your own request.
approval.rejectText: The invoice stays as it is. The requester will read your explanation.

approvalNotice.DISCOUNT: Discount of {amount} waiting for a supervisor’s approval. Until it is decided, the invoice can no longer be changed.
approvalNotice.CANCEL: Cancellation waiting for a supervisor’s approval. Until it is decided, the invoice can no longer be changed.
approvalNotice.outdated: The invoice has changed since this request: a supervisor can only reject it.

cancelRequest.title: Request the cancellation
cancelRequest.warningText: An issued invoice cannot be cancelled on your own. Your request goes to a supervisor; the invoice can no longer be changed until they decide.

lab.auditNote: This action is recorded in the audit log with your identity.

worklist.title: Worklist
worklist.lead: Lab requests, most urgent first. Open one to collect, receive or reject its specimens.
worklist.leadOwn: Your lab requests and their progress: collection, receipt at the lab.

collect.title: Collect {barcode}
collect.warningText: Read the wristband and ask the patient for their date of birth. A mismatch blocks the collection and the attempt is logged.
collect.patientNumberHint: First identifier, read on the wristband.
collect.birthDateHint: Second identifier, confirmed by the patient (YYYY-MM-DD).

reject.title: Reject {barcode}
reject.warningTitle: A new collection will be requested
reject.warningText: The specimen stays in the history; a new tube with a new barcode is planned for the same tests.
reject.done: Specimen {barcode} rejected: a new collection is planned.

cancelRequest.title: Cancel the request
cancelRequest.warningText: The specimens will no longer be processed. Not possible once a specimen has reached the lab.

new.title: New lab request
new.lead: Choose the patient, then the tests to perform. A specimen is planned for each tube type.
new.notesHint: Useful for the analysis (500 characters at most).

catalog.title: Test catalog
catalog.lead: The laboratory’s tests: specimen, turnaround time and reference ranges.
catalog.name: Test

result.title: Results
result.waitingReceipt: Waiting for the specimen to be received.
result.inProgress: Result being processed by the laboratory.
result.needOther: To be verified by a technician other than {name}.
result.needOtherRelease: To be released by a technician other than {name}.
result.blockedCritical: Release blocked: the call to the clinician must be documented.
result.valueHintNumeric: A number (comma or dot, 6 decimals at most).
result.amended: Result of {name} amended: to be verified then released.
result.returnWarningTitle: The result goes back to its author
result.returnWarningText: It must be re-entered, then verified again. Explain why.
result.amendWarningTitle: The released result will be amended
result.amendWarningText: A new version is created, to be verified then released. The prescriber keeps reading the released version meanwhile.
result.notifyWarningText: Call the clinician, have the value read back aloud, then document the call: release depends on it.
result.readBack: The person notified read the value back aloud
result.verifyAllHint: Verifies every result entered by another technician.
result.batchNone: No result for you to process.

report.title: Laboratory report
report.partialText: Some results are not released yet: they appear as “pending”.

manage.codeHint: Letters, digits, “_”, “-”, “.” (20 at most). Cannot be changed later.
manage.name: Name
manage.rangesHint: Ages in days (18 years ≈ 6,574 days). The maximum age is excluded; leave it empty for “no limit”. Thresholds: critical low ≤ low ≤ high ≤ critical high.
manage.rangeInvalid: Band {n}: enter valid numbers (minimum age in whole days, at least one limit).
manage.noRanges: No band: results will not get a position (normal, low, high).
